method.inputs: The event adapter stores the actual keydown/keyup callbacks registered by InputState. Only those original callbacks receive synthetic native key events; held/pressed/released sets are never edited by this harness.
method.simulation: Public FightEngine.update() and FightEngine.render() run real intros, movement, gravity, body separation, facing, sprite clocks, guard and rendering.
method.observation: A wrapper calls the real native Canvas drawImage, then records image identity, draw arguments, transform and a read-only actor snapshot.
method.assets: Exact source PNG file bytes are checked against their manifest. Sharp normalizes PNG encoding only in memory for native decoding, with decoded RGBA equality checked.
method.stateWrites: No actor position, pose, facing, health, velocity, sprite clock, presentation, camera or phase is assigned by the harness.
method.output: Only this output directory receives the report and actual native Canvas captures.

limits: Native Canvas is not Chromium. DOM, CSS, browser decoding, real keyboard delivery, HTTP, service workers and CI browser behavior are not exercised.
Synthetic native events are delivered to the actual InputState callbacks. They are not represented as trusted browser events.
Two exact 28-tick versus walk cycles per direction are exercised. The seven-tick timing is authored for this game, not measured source timing.
The opposite view is the engine mirror of the same combat PNGs, not an independently sourced left-side image.
An ordinary jump above Creeper is used only to change sides. Missing jump art may use idle fallback; no dedicated jump animation is claimed.
Source anatomy, textures, scale, weapons, collision fidelity and fidelity 1:1 still require visual/source review.
The chosen room and small parallax are reconstructed versus presentation. This is not source animation certification.
No attack catalogue, mobile, gamepad, offline or browser security workaround is tested.

roles.observedBasis: Attaque à la seringue : Le bestiaire Origins décrit une infirmière au visage absent qui attaque avec une seringue. Les vues PSP de l’uniforme, de la main et de la seringue distinguent ce sujet du couteau Homecoming et du tuyau SH2. Les cinq commandes spéciales du prototype déclinent un contact de seringue local : elles ne constituent pas cinq gestes natifs, ni une injection certifiée de dos, à distance ou à travers une cible au sol. Les durées, doses et dégâts restent versus.
roles.superDescription: Chorégraphie originale : anticipation centrée sur « seringue », enchaînement limité autour de « Attaque à la seringue », puis récupération exposée; aucun nouveau pouvoir ajouté.
